rv.q: There are only a few times when you will witness a theatrical performance that is so captivating and enthralling that it will knock your socks off.
It’s a performance full of joy.
All in all, this is the story of personal liberation as achieved through a hybrid of musical styles and the friendship of opposites.
These two ladies sparkle with their character development as well as their musical talents and when it comes to singing, there ain’t none better!

cn.t: Critics rave about this captivating production, with stellar performances and direction bringing the story of gospel pioneers Sister Rosetta Tharpe and Marie Knight to electrifying life through powerful music and emotionally resonant storytelling.
